mainQuestExcel.title: Alright, Iaune, Alright
mainQuestExcel.description: Iaune is in the café, sighing...

dialogs.text: *sigh* I don't know why this happened...
Iaune?
Oh, Traveler, nice to meet you. Are you here for some coffee? I'll treat you to a cup.
What's wrong? You look terrible. Has someone been forcing you to stay up late again?
Thanks for your concern. However, this is my own issue this time.
I've been thinking... About the meaning of my work.
I've always believed the Maison Gestion to be a just, efficient, strong organization in which everyone is willing to help each other.
I believe that under its management, the Court of Fontaine would see itself develop positively.
But the way I see it now, it is a ruined mechanical house. Its gears, levers, and apertures are being pulled chaotically... Only its facade remains pristine.
It only operates because of a series of coincidences and lessons, not precise consideration or design.
I... I want to do something about it, but I can't. I fear that one mistake on my part will send this house tumbling down.
Roialte always tells me to relax a bit, since my mistakes cannot make things worse than they already are...
Th—That's an odd way of comforting someone...
*sigh* Sorry, I shouldn't complain. I came out here to get away from all that for a while, after all...
I'll make you a cup of coffee.
Really? You know how to brew coffee? That's amazing — I've always wanted to learn, but I can never find the time.
I'll leave it to you, then. I'll wait here... and with any luck, work won't catch up with me at the café.
Are you on leave today?
Traveler, have you come to help us out? You're most welcome!
No, no, we're just here to help a friend make some coffee. He's just... Well...
He's feeling a bit down.
By "a friend," do you mean Iaune — you know, the fellow sitting over there?
You know him?
Roialte and I are old friends. He mentioned that a bright, hardworking fellow came to their office recently, and that's Iaune.
Don't you worry too much about him — young people who've just started at the Maison Gestion will always find themselves a little dejected at first.
They'll be fine once they find a place for themselves there.
You sound very experienced. Why's that?
Well, I was once a radish planted in the field that is the Maison Gestion, too.
But I wasn't satisfied with being a mere radish, and so I left my lot and... opened this café some time later.
Sounds like a lot happened...
Hahaha, perhaps! But nowadays, I'm just a café owner.
Alright, weren't you going to make Iaune a cup of coffee? I'll go adjust the device — come find me once you're ready.
Sounds like a real trove of stories to be told...
He's feeling the pressure.
I'm ready.
I've prepared all the needed ingredients. They're over there, so you can start brewing any time.
I've got other matters to attend to at the moment...
Make your preparations, then come find me.
A mechanical house... Will I eventually become a broken gear within it someday?
Well? Ready to make Iaune his cup of coffee?
I'm ready.
I've prepared all the needed ingredients. They're over there, so you can start brewing any time.
I've got other matters to attend to at the moment...
Make your preparations, then come find me.
A mechanical house... Will I eventually become a broken gear within it someday?
What should we put into the coffee this time?
A mechanical house... Will I eventually become a broken gear within it someday?
That sounds great! Time to start blending, then!
You start brewing coffee...
Ooh, that smells good! Now let's hand it to Iaune. Paimon sure hopes it cheers him up!
Traveler... You really made me that cup of coffee? Um, I... Sorry for troubling you...
Don't worry about it.
This coffee... It's way better than the stuff provided at the Maison Gestion! In fact, it's in a whole different dimension...
If this was the coffee I drank every day, I wouldn't spend so much time teetering on the brink of sleep.
Thanks for the coffee. I'll head back to work once I finish it.
Do your best.
I will. I need to grow into my work as soon as possible and stand on my own two feet like Roialte does.
*sigh* I just wonder how many nightmares I'll have to endure before then...
Keep your chin up.
Just drink up.

questNarration.text: The ingredients are added. The Traveler's Special Blend is complete.
